     - Net.Amount = 83.26 (matches taxable).
     - Vat.Amount = 0.00.

6. Verify decimal preservation and formatting:

   - GrandTotal.Amount is numeric 83.26; Net.Amount 83.26; Vat.Amount 0.00. Vat.Rate left empty (no numeric percent in text).

7. Ensure required fields covered:
   - GrandTotal.Amount: 83.26
   - Invoice.Date: "30/01/2023"
   - Sender.VatId: "IT00098090210"
   - Vat.Rate: "" (absent)
   - Net.Amount: 83.26

No other relevant invoice-wide exchange rates or VAT groups needing extraction were found.
